procedures.subject: E42 pump fault
procedures.rule: For an E42 pump fault, measure inlet pressure first. If it is below 4 bar, restore inlet pressure and retest; do not replace the pump. If pressure is at least 4 bar and E42 persists after retesting, replace the pump.

procedures.subject: R17 controller fault
procedures.rule: For an R17 controller fault, measure supply voltage first. If it is below 22 V, fix the supply and retest; do not replace the controller. If voltage is at least 22 V and R17 persists after retesting, replace the controller.

procedures.subject: T09 cooler fault
procedures.rule: For a T09 cooler fault, check ambient temperature first. If it is above 31 C, lower the ambient temperature and retest; do not replace the cooler. If ambient temperature is at most 31 C and T09 persists after retesting, replace the cooler.
